(TSX: THNC), the leading learning commerce platform for scaling external training, today announced a product integration and a commercial partnership. Starting today, eligible customers licensed for both platforms can publish content created in Articulate 360 AI directly to Thinkific Plus with one click, eliminating manual exports, re-packaging and reuploads. This is Articulate's first native integration with a third-party LMS.
A seamless connection between creation and delivery

Until now, companies using Articulate to build professional training content and Thinkific to deliver it to external audiences relied on a manual workflow: export, re-package, re-upload, repeat. For organizations that manage large volumes of content and multiple authors, that friction carries real business costs: slower launches, version control inconsistencies, and learning programs that are difficult to maintain.

The new integration connects those workflows. Articulate and Thinkific customers can now bring interactive, SCORM-compliant content from Articulate 360 AI into their Thinkific Plus learning programs with a single click. They can also open Articulate Rise directly from Thinkific when they need to edit content and republish to Thinkific with one click.

"Publishing a Rise 360 course today means generating a package, downloading it, and then uploading it into Thinkific and repeating that process every time the content changes," said Renee Tomlinson, Executive Director, ESCO Institute. "A direct integration will not only save time and reduce the opportunity for errors, but also make it much easier to keep our training accurate and up to date. We're excited to put it to work!"

“Businesses come to Thinkific to turn learning into revenue, and the faster they can bring new courses to market, the faster that happens," said Amanda Malko, Chief Revenue Officer of Thinkific. "Pairing the proprietary workplace training that customers build on Articulate with Thinkific’s learning commerce platform removes the busywork between building training and getting it in front of learners."

For organizations using both platforms, Articulate 360 AI serves as the production studio, where training and education teams create professional-grade, interactive learning content faster with AI backed by two decades of learning science. Thinkific serves as the delivery engine and learner experience platform, where those organizations bring that content to customers, partners, channel teams and members through branded learning programs designed to drive measurable business outcomes.

"We've seen thousands of organizations build training that changes how people perform, and the teams that get results are the ones whose tools let them focus on the quality of the content and the learning experience," said Monika Saha, Chief Commercial Officer at Articulate. "Thinkific shares our conviction that training only matters if the business is different afterward. This partnership makes it easier for our joint customers to work that way."

The integration is available to eligible Thinkific Plus and Articulate 360 AI customers starting today. This release also covers Articulate Rise, the web-based authoring solution within Articulate 360 AI. To learn more, visit

Articulate is the #1 platform for workplace training trusted by 125,000 organizations worldwide, including 100% of the Fortune 100. Articulate is rated No.1 in the course authoring platform category and No.1 in the enterprise software company in 2026 on G2, the world’s largest and most trusted data source on B2B software for its customer-driven reviews and rankings. With over two decades of proprietary data on what makes people learn and drives performance change at work, Articulate is building the system that powers workforce capability in the age of AI. Learn more at articulate.com.

Thinkific (TSX:THNC) is an award-winning learning commerce platform built for scale. Thinkific gives businesses everything they need to sell online learning experiences and grow their revenue — all from one AI-powered platform. Tens of thousands of customers — including companies like GoDaddy, Nasdaq, and ActiveCampaign — have generated billions in revenue using Thinkific, impacting more than 200 million people worldwide. For more information, please visit www.thinkific.com.
